reason: Hypothesis B proposes a specific, physically sound thermomechanical route (cryogenic rolling + annealing) to create a heterogeneous lamellar microstructure that directly addresses cracking and load-bearing integrity, while explicitly predicting preserved caloric performance and providing a clear falsification experiment; it extends prior findings on cryo-rolling in HEAs to a new material system.
